tool_input.description: Run tools check over scripts and tests
List user ruff config and worktree root

result:
The research for w98 is done, and the notes and result file are in the run directory. The checkout is unchanged: `git status --porcelain` is empty.

None of the four accepted scenarios (six node ids, counting the three-row outline) is red today. All six pass. The real work is the ruff and vulture findings that make `python3 scripts/tools check scripts tests` exit 1:

- **ruff:** 690 findings, 522 of them UP031. Exact counts come from a probe running `ruff check --statistics`.
- **vulture:** one finding, an unused `none` parameter in `tests/scenarios/feature_file_tools_given_steps.py:122`. pytest-bdd passes that name as a keyword, so it has to stay a parameter.
- **Fix list:** 91 Python files, plus a new ruff config that leaves UP031 and a mode or shebang fix for `tests/scripts/stub_claude.py`. No file is over 300 lines; the tightest is `design_model_check_problems.py` at 288.
- **Ruff config:** the checkout has no ruff config, so the current rules come from a source I could not identify. A new project config would replace that source, so it has to list every rule the project keeps.

One defect is noted, not fixed. Two `tools map` tests in `tests/scripts/test_tools.py` fail in this session because the map's pytest run reports `--work-item w98: no such work-item under .shop/work/`. I did not confirm whether the cause is the environment or the repository.

Coverage claims are by search, because `tools map` was not run (it would run the whole suite) and `tools tests-of` refuses without a map.

Result: `DONE`, with no questions.
